value.visualThesis: A friendly-authoritative SaaS-agency system for RankForge Kenya: a dark violet photographic hero mass anchors the page, followed by a long light-gray body of badge-titled sections with faint lavender tints, an unusually tall asymmetric services card collection as the commercial core, narrative splits with floating chips, violet pill accordion FAQ, a photo-backed proof band with overlaid cards, and dark newsletter/contact/footer masses framing the bottom. Three-family type stack (Figtree display, Montserrat H2, Poppins body/UI) with capitalize transforms; saturated violet pill buttons with trailing arrow icons are the only strong accent against neutral surfaces. Dark top and bottom, light middle, violet for action only.

signatureTraits.description: Full-bleed ~1.07-viewport hero (region-2) with a photographic background of people working under a dark purple wash (rgb(48,32,64)-family, luminance <70), carrying the 60px Figtree display headline 'Get found when your customers are already searching.' and a violet pill CTA.

Header bar with centered inline navigation (Poppins 15px/600, capitalize) and a distinct violet pill CTA ('Request an SEO Consultation') at the header's right; compact collapsing mobile menu keeps the pill CTA reachable.

Near-full-height (~870px) light editorial split: large portrait-orientation photo displayed ~500px wide inside a soft lavender circular/blob mask on the left, dense multi-bullet copy on the right under a Montserrat 40px H2 with violet pill badge.

Tallest region (~1.86 viewports) holding the six RankForge SEO services as an asymmetric card collection: 4-across icon-chip card row, then 2-across wide cards, then remaining cards; equal white rounded cards with icon tops and per-card violet pill 'Learn more' actions.

Two sequential narrative splits pairing medium person/environment imagery with copy and small floating cards; chips carry non-quantitative labels (process stage numbers 01–04, focus labels) since RankForge permits no invented statistics.

~760px light FAQ region with left flat-illustration montage and right-stacked violet pill-shaped accordion rows — first item expanded in dark text, remaining items as saturated violet pills with trailing chevrons.

Full-bleed office-photography backdrop (luminance mid-darkened) with white rounded cards and one dark accent quote/positioning card overlaid on the left half; for RankForge this band carries positioning/proof-of-approach cards, not invented client testimonials.

Compact (~341px) newsletter band with inline name/email fields, then a ~720px dark contact region beginning with a near-black full-width conversion banner ('Ready to make organic search work harder…' + 'Talk to RankForge') flowing into a dense multi-column dark footer.

fidelityPriorities: 1. Page silhouette and surface sequence: dark hero → light body with lavender tints → photo mass → dark banner/footer framing — the dominant perceived identity.
2. First viewport: full-bleed dark-violet photographic hero with 60px display headline and violet pill CTA.
3. Violet pill button/badge system with trailing icons — every CTA, badge and FAQ row.
4. Region topology: the 12-region order including the unusually tall services collection (~1.86 viewports).
5. Typography relationships: three-family stack with Figtree display, Montserrat 40px H2, Poppins 16px body, capitalize transforms.
6. Photographic grammar: darkened collaborative-office backdrops, masked portrait blob, medium posed-person shots, flat icon/illustration chips.
7. Spacing rhythm and alternating light/dark mass sequencing.
8. Motion: scroll-reveal reveals and floating chips (substituted per Adaptation Contract), accordion behavior.

globalGrid.containerLogic: Page max 1440px full-width with full-bleed section surfaces; inner content constrained to ~1200px centered container. Splits use 50/50 or 55/45 asymmetric two-column grids. Card collection uses 4-across, 2-across wide, and 4-across row patterns within the 1200px container. Header uses full-width bar with content aligned to the same 1200px container. Text blocks cap at ~640px measure.

value.spacingRhythm: Editorial long-scroll rhythm: generous section paddings (~96–160px desktop, tightening on mobile) between major regions, with intentional exceptions — hero is taller than one viewport, the services collection is deliberately ~1.86 viewports with moderate internal row gaps, and the newsletter band is compact (~341px). Consistent ~40–64px gaps between card rows; ~24–32px card internal padding.

typographyRoles.description: Figtree 700, 60px/78px desktop (clamp to 36px mobile), capitalize, white on dark hero; single largest text mass, 2–3 lines.
Montserrat 700, 40px/48px, 0.8px tracking, capitalize, dark text on light surfaces; each section typically preceded by a small violet pill badge label.
Figtree 700 bold paragraph-level role, 40px/40px with 0.8px tracking (scale down responsively); used for card titles and split sub-headings, creating compressed hierarchy below H2.
Poppins 400, 16px/22.4px, rgb(55,65,81); measure 55–75 characters; multi-bullet lists permitted in about split.
Poppins 15px/600, capitalize, used for header links, pill CTA labels and badges; on violet pills in white.
Small violet pill label, Poppins 13–15px/600 capitalize white, placed above section H2s.
Poppins 600 14–16px for floating narrative chips; dark text on white rounded cards or white on violet.

colorRoles.description: Saturated violet #8E2DE2 (with #4E2FDA deep variant) used ONLY as action/accent: pill CTAs, badges, FAQ pills, icon chips. Low-to-mid page frequency; never floods surfaces.
Near-black rgb(16,16,16) for the contact banner and newsletter-adjacent mass; dark footer bands rgb(80,80,80)/rgb(64,48,48) family.
Dark purple photographic overlay rgb(48,32,64)→rgb(96,64,112) gradient wash over hero and proof-band photography, luminance kept low (<70) for text contrast.
Neutral light gray rgb(240,240,240) and body rgb(249,250,251) carry most of the page mass.
Faint lavender rgb(240,224,255) used occasionally on specific bands and masks, never as page-wide fill.
rgb(17,24,39)-family headings, rgb(55,65,81) body, white text on dark/violet surfaces.

value.surfaceLanguage: Friendly rounded geometry: white cards at ~16px radius with subtle borders/shadows on light gray bands; pill radius (999px) for all buttons, badges and FAQ rows; ~12px radius for icon chips. Soft lavender circular/blob mask on the about portrait. Photography surfaces are darkened by purple overlays rather than gradients-as-decoration. No glassmorphism, no heavy gradients outside the hero/proof photographic washes, no textures. Depth comes from card elevation and surface alternation, not ornament.
value.headerNavigation: Full-width header bar (~143px desktop, compressing on mobile): logo left within the 1200px container; centered inline navigation strip (~568px, Poppins 15px/600 capitalize, ~7 links); violet pill CTA ('Request an SEO Consultation') pinned right. Light surface over the dark hero or transparent-over-hero treatment per screenshot; compresses to a compact mobile menu pattern keeping the pill CTA reachable. Static or subtly scrolled-state surface; no mega-menu.

homepageFirstViewport.summary: Header bar plus a full-bleed ~1.07-viewport dark-violet photographic hero (region-2). Background is a candid collaborative-office photograph under a dark purple wash (rgb(48,32,64) dominant, luminance <70). Left-weighted content: 60px Figtree capitalize white headline ('Get found when your customers are already searching.'), 2–3 lines, ~640px block, supporting Poppins body copy (~50–80 words), then a violet pill primary CTA ('Request an SEO Consultation') and a secondary link/pill ('Explore Our Services'). Text-safe negative space preserved in the photography. Slight hint of the next light region visible at the fold is acceptable. Mobile: headline stacks, image crops centered, CTA full-width stack.

homepageRegions.purpose: Dark violet full-bleed photographic hero: display headline, supporting organic-visibility copy, primary 'Request an SEO Consultation' pill CTA and secondary 'Explore Our Services' action. Aggregates header/nav strip and hero mass into one compositional unit.

Light near-full-height editorial split introducing RankForge's approach: portrait photo in lavender blob mask left, badge + Montserrat H2 and multi-bullet copy right (technical understanding, search behaviour, content strategy, commercial thinking, disciplined prioritisation).

Light strip with centered Montserrat heading and a horizontal row of ~5 desaturated marks. Because RankForge permits no invented client logos, this becomes a 'who we work with' capability strip: sectors served (SMEs, professional services, ecommerce, hospitality, B2B) as desaturated text-mark/sector chips at reduced visual weight.

The commercial core: ~1.86-viewport asymmetric collection presenting exactly the six RankForge services (SEO Strategy, Technical SEO, Local SEO, SEO Content Strategy, Ecommerce SEO, SEO Audits) as white rounded cards with icon chips, laid out as 4-across, 2-across wide, then remaining cards, each with a violet pill action.

Two sequential narrative splits presenting the four-stage process (Diagnose, Prioritise, Execute, Improve): alternating image/copy alignment with floating chips carrying stage numbers (01–04) and stage names — no invented statistics.

Light FAQ band: left flat-illustration montage, right violet pill accordion rows (first expanded dark-text, rest saturated violet pills with chevrons) answering common SEO service questions within factual constraints.

Full-bleed darkened office-photography band with overlaid white rounded cards and one dark accent card on the left half. Carries RankForge positioning/proof-of-approach messaging cards (e.g. 'SEO built around commercial growth, not vanity metrics', problem statements) — no invented testimonials or metrics.
Compact ~341px band with inline name and email fields and submit pill, submitting via the central WAZIBIZ Form Service (platform sender identity; visitor email as Reply-To).

Dark contact/footer region: near-black full-width conversion banner ('Ready to make organic search work harder for your business?' + 'Talk to RankForge' pill), contact bridge (hello@rankforgekenya.example, Nairobi, Kenya), then dense multi-column dark footer navigation.

imageSystem.photographyGrammar: Business-context documentary-commercial photography, not product display. Candid collaborative-office scenes of people working at laptops for hero and proof-band backdrops, darkened under purple washes for overlaid-text readability. One portrait-orientation medium shot of a person at a device for the about split, masked in a soft lavender blob. Medium lightly-posed person shots with clean light/lavender backgrounds for narrative splits. Flat colorful illustration/icon figures (~90px chips, square sources) for service cards and FAQ montage — illustration material, not photography, for those roles. Warm-neutral color, moderate contrast, restrained backgrounds, text-safe negative space where copy overlaps. Avoid: macro product shots, dramatic cinematic lighting, desaturated editorial fashion treatment, sterile studio backgrounds, generic handshake stock poses.

imageRoles.purpose: Full-bleed collaborative-office photograph under dark violet wash supporting hero headline and pill CTA; landscape/panoramic, people at laptops, text-safe left negative space. CRITICAL — identity-defining.
Portrait-orientation (2:3) medium shot of one person working at a device, displayed ~500px inside a soft lavender circular/blob mask on a light surface. CRITICAL.
Small square flat-color icon/illustration chips (~90px, 1:1) topping the six service cards; illustration material, not photography. HIGH.
Two medium shots of lightly-posed single people with laptop/tablet against clean light or lavender backgrounds, with floating stage-number chips; alternate left/right alignment. HIGH.
Flat colorful illustration montage (~90px figures, mixed) beside the FAQ accordion. NORMAL.
Full-bleed darkened office photograph as backdrop for overlaid white/dark cards in the proof band. HIGH.

motionGrammar: Scroll-triggered reveal transitions on section content and cards (substituting reference parallax per Adaptation Contract): fade + modest 16–24px upward travel, 350–600ms, staggered ~80ms within card rows.
Floating narrative chips receive a subtle slower drift/parallax-lite cue via transform on reveal; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.
Accordion rows expand/collapse with ~300ms ease; chevron rotates; only one item open at a time.
Violet pill buttons: background deepens toward #4E2FDA with subtle shadow lift on hover, 200ms; focus-visible ring in accessible contrast.
Hero and proof-band backgrounds are static crops (no parallax per Adaptation Contract).
Reduced motion: all reveals render instantly visible; content, focus and state feedback preserved.
responsiveContract: 375px mobile retains all regions — single-column stacking, no content removal.
Services collection rows (4-across, 2-across) collapse to stacked single-column cards, each retaining icon chip and pill CTA.
Split regions (about, narrative) stack image above copy; portrait scales within its blob mask.
Centered nav strip collapses into compact mobile menu; header height compresses; pill CTA remains reachable.
Full-bleed photo regions (hero, proof band) crop imagery with object-fit cover while retaining overlaid headline/cards.
Trusted strip reduces to a wrapped or scrollable smaller set.
No horizontal overflow at any breakpoint; touch targets ≥44px; mobile type scales per clamp tokens while retaining capitalize transforms and family character.
innerPageVocabulary: HERO_BANNER_LIGHT: compact light page-header with badge + Montserrat H2 + short intro (About/Services/Contact).
EDITORIAL_SPLIT_BLOB: 50/50 split with masked portrait/media and multi-bullet copy (About approach).
CARD_COLLECTION_ASYMMETRIC: 4/2/4 card rows for service detail pages (Services).
NARRATIVE_SPLIT_CHIPS: alternating media/copy with floating label chips (process/principle pages).
ACCORDION_PILL_STACK: violet pill FAQ/principle accordion beside illustration montage.
CONTACT_SPLIT: form fields (Name, Company, Email, Phone, Website, help-with select, Message) beside dark info panel with contact bridge.
QUIET_CTA_BAND: compact conversion band reusing the violet pill system before the dark footer.
antiFallbackRules: Do not flatten the ~1.86-viewport services collection into a uniform 3-column grid — preserve the 4/2/4 asymmetric rhythm.
Do not replace the dark-violet photographic hero with a plain colored or gradient-only hero.
Do not remove the lavender blob mask from the about portrait in favor of a plain rectangle.
Do not restyle pill CTAs, badges or FAQ rows as squares or sharp rectangles.
Do not flood the page with violet — accent frequency stays low-to-mid on neutral light surfaces.
Do not add glassmorphism, heavy gradients or textures absent from the reference.
Do not center every heading — preserve left-weighted hero and split copy alignment.
Do not drop the black contact banner + dark multi-column footer sequence in favor of a single slim footer.
Do not invent testimonials, statistics or client logos to fill the proof band or trusted strip.
accessibilityAdaptations: White-on-violet pills and white-on-dark text meet WCAG AA contrast; body text rgb(55,65,81) on light surfaces.
Hero/proof photographic washes darkened to guarantee ≥4.5:1 overlay text contrast.
Visible focus rings on all pills, nav links, accordion rows and form fields.
Accordion implemented with proper button/aria-expanded semantics; no hover-only essential behavior.
prefers-reduced-motion disables reveals, chip drift and parallax substitutes.
No horizontal overflow; readable mobile type floor ~16px body.
Form fields labeled; select options match the seven permitted help-with values.
declaredLimitations: Adaptation Contract: heavy parallax choreography replaced by static composition plus scroll reveals and reduced parallax-lite chip cues (feature token mass:parallax-substitute).

Reference stat/metric chips ('45.80%' style) cannot carry numbers for RankForge (no invented statistics) — chips adapted to stage numbers 01–04 and focus labels while preserving chip geometry and floating placement.
Reference client logos in the trusted strip cannot be reproduced — adapted to desaturated sector/capability text-marks at equivalent visual weight and layout.
Reference testimonial copy/cards adapted to positioning/problem-statement cards over the same photographic backdrop; card geometry preserved.
Exact reference fonts used via Google Fonts (Figtree, Montserrat, Poppins) with sans-serif fallbacks; measured timing values unavailable — motion durations are best-practice estimates.
No invented business facts: testimonials, clients, rankings, team, office address, awards and quantitative claims are all omitted per Business Facts constraints.
